Elapsed time per attempt is measured directly rather than relying on an external interrupting timer, and the loop breaks as soon as a slow call is observed, keeping total runtime bounded. If the malicious call throws instead of hanging, that is treated as a blocked exploit (operation_completed=true, exploit_succeeded=false).
